spec2def(shdoclc.dll shdoclc.spec)

# shdoclc.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/shdoclc-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
add_cargo_module(shdoclc shdoclc-cargo shdoclc.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
add_dependencies(shdoclc psdk)
